facts.fact: The 2026 state budget (final maps) appropriates MZN 111,260,610 for operations of the Ministry of Communications and Digital Transformation's central apparatus; the ministry's investment budget of MZN 2,637,800,000 is wholly externally financed and is not counted. Date is the document's published month (2026-01).
